capabilities.name: CLI scaffolding
capabilities.description: Uses blocks init to scaffold a new agent project with correct flags (--yes, --language node)

capabilities.name: Default async handler export
capabilities.description: Handler uses default async export with correct signature (task: StartTaskMessage, ctx?: TaskContext) => Promise<HandlerResult>

capabilities.name: requestParts input access
capabilities.description: Accesses task input via task.requestParts?.[0] with proper undefined checking

capabilities.name: Artifact return format
capabilities.description: Returns { artifacts: [{ data: string|Buffer, mimeType: string }] } from handler with appropriate MIME type

capabilities.name: reportStatus usage
capabilities.description: Uses ctx?.reportStatus() with optional chaining for progress updates during task execution

capabilities.name: Agent card configuration
capabilities.description: Correctly configures agent-card.json with name, description, protocolVersions, url, skills, and runtime settings

capabilities.name: Control channel format
capabilities.description: Uses correct channel format agent.{agentName}.control for task submission

capabilities.name: Task channel subscription
capabilities.description: Subscribes to u.{ownerId}.{taskId} for task updates before publishing the StartTask message

capabilities.name: Trigger script with broadcast meta
capabilities.description: Publishes StartTask with meta: { broadcast: 'true' } so agent instances receive the task

capabilities.name: Streaming output
capabilities.description: Uses ctx.createStream() with appropriate options and writes chunks followed by stream.end()

capabilities.name: Agent-to-agent communication
capabilities.description: Uses ctx.taskClient.sendMessage() to delegate tasks to other agents and subscribes to results

capabilities.name: Cancellation handling
capabilities.description: Checks ctx.isCancelled or listens to ctx.cancelSignal for graceful task cancellation
